meta.title: Add paged decode helper to Llama transformer
meta.body_summary: Add a _forward helper to reuse logic between decoding calls and implement per-layer paged decode in the Llama transformer; also fix ragged attention axis names and rename variables flagged by ruff.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added paged decode helper; no review or performance evidence; PR self-closed after ~3.7 days without engagement.

core_change_summary.description: Added a `_forward` helper in llama.py to share logic between decoding calls; implemented per-layer paged decode using that helper; updated `default_ragged_paged_attention` in attention.py to handle alternate axis names; minor variable renames for ruff compliance.
change_trajectory: Single commit refactored decode logic, added paged attention, handled axis names, and applied ruff fixes.
